subject: Security exhibit: proposed redlines, evidence owners, and pen-test window
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood-inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Security exhibit: quick triage and next steps

Team — forwarding the request from GreenBridge (below). They shared a set of asks around SOC 2 evidence, pen-test windows, and some proposed audit-rights language in their order form. I’ve attached their original doc and a quick evidence mapping they sent. High level asks:

- Confirm SOC 2 availability (type & date range) and what artifacts we can share.
- Pen-test calendar: they want a 30-day window for our annual test and optional one-off retests tied to major releases.
- Audit rights: redline asking for on-site access + log ingestion for in-scope systems. They’ve proposed very broad language.

Immediate asks for this thread:
1) Legal (Karthik) — can you propose language that preserves our current limitation (reports + on-site with notice + scoped access) and push back on \"unfettered\" access? I sketched a couple lines in redlines_v2.docx.
2) Security (Soojinn/Priyom) — please confirm what evidence we can provide (SOC 2 Type II pdf, control narratives, pen-test summary) and the feasibility of a 30-day window for scheduled testing. Also indicate owners for each evidence item. I dropped an evidence_mapping.xlsx with suggested owners.
3) Sales/AM (Laura) — we should keep GreenBridge commercial happy but not open the door to continuous audit burden. Would appreciate any customer context you have on why this level is requested (regulatory, internal audit, procurement).

I’ll consolidate language and send a single redline packet back to the customer.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_v2.docx (proposed MSA/Order Form edits), evidence_mapping.xlsx (draft owner matrix)

From: Tom Bishop <ciso@greenbridge.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Legal Counsel <outsidecounsel@greenbridge.com>, security@greenbridge.com
Date: 2026-11-08T11:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit: quick triage and next steps

Alex — thanks for the fast reply and for looping in Legal/Sec. A few clarifying notes from GreenBridge:

- We are running against an internal compliance calendar tied to a customer audit in Q1 that requires documented evidence of vendor controls. SOC 2 Type II for the last 12 months is preferred.
- For pen testing: we ask vendors to provide a 30-day window option so our security team can observe and validate remediation timelines where applicable. We do not intend to request continuous live access; the ask is to ensure our test schedule can align with vendor testing windows.
- On audit rights: our preferred language allows for review of systems in scope and access to relevant logs. We understand vendors may not provide raw log ingestion — a compromise model that has worked with other vendors is: SOC 2 + a remote interview with the vendor security lead, plus a mutually-agreed on-site review under NDA if needed.

I attached a SOC checklist and our proposed order-form clause (see soc2_summary.pdf). If you can propose a path that gives us comparable assurance without undermining your operational model, that should be fine.

Happy to jump on a call if it helps — we’re flexible on timing this week.

Tom Bishop
CISO, GreenBridge Analytics
security@greenbridge.com

Attachment: soc2_summary.pdf (GreenBridge checklist and suggested OF clause)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Security exhibit: quick triage and next steps

Alex — thanks for bubbling this up. Quick answers from Security: 

- SOC 2: We have a current SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30. We can share the report (redacted where necessary), control mapping, and a one-page summary. We cannot share raw evidence (screenshots of internal dashboards, raw logs) without an executed NDA and a scoped request.

- Pen test: Our annual external penetration test is scheduled for the week of 2026-11-22; we can offer a 30-day window centered on that date (i.e., range 2026-11-08 through 2026-12-08) for customers who want to observe. For off-cycle requests, we typically allow one operational retest per calendar year with two weeks notice, subject to operational gating. We will need a list of IPs/targets and a test plan 7 business days before the start.

- Evidence owners (see evidence_mapping.xlsx):
  - SOC 2 report & summary — Soojin (Security)
  - Control narratives — Priyom (Security/Compliance)
  - Pen-test summary (executive) — Vendor + Soojin
  - Live interviews / on-site reviews — Security and Engineering leads (scoped)

Proposed compromise for audit clause: vendor provides SOC 2 + control mapping + one remote interview with security lead, and on-site review only when justified and under mutually agreed NDA/statement of scope. We should push back on any phrase that grants \"unfettered access\" or open-ended rights to pull logs.

I’ve added these edits to redlines_v2.docx (highlighted). Also flagged a few operational asks that need legal sign-off (notification period, scope definition, and required test-plan timeline).

-Soojin
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_mapping.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Security exhibit: quick triage and next steps

Team — reviewed Soojin’s edits and Tom’s note. Key legal positions I’ll propose back to GreenBridge: 

1) Audit-rights language: Accept SOC 2 Type II + control mapping + one remote interview as standard. On-site reviews limited to cases where GreenBridge presents a specific, documented compliance requirement tied to an incident or regulator request; any on-site engagement will be: (a) subject to at least 30 days' notice, (b) scoped in writing, and (c) executed under Redwood’s standard audit playbook and NDA. This should replace any broad \"system access\" phrasing.

2) Pen-test coordination: Confirmed — we can offer a 30-day observation window around our annual test and one operational retest per year for customers with prior notice. We will require a test plan and target list 7 business days prior and request a point-of-contact for remediation verification.

3) Evidence sharing: We will provide SOC 2 reports and executive summaries; raw evidence or production log exports will not be provided except under a court order or regulator demand. For audits requiring deeper evidence, we can offer a secure, time-boxed review with redaction protocols and a signed data handling addendum.

Next steps: I’ll produce a redline packet to send to GreenBridge with alternative language and ask them to confirm whether the SOC 2 report + interview model is acceptable. Alex/Laura — are you okay with me sending this back tomorrow? I’ve attached the proposed OF language in redlines_v2.docx; I’ll update it with the final legal markup.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
General Counsel (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines_v2.docx (legal markup forthcoming)

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Tom Bishop <ciso@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Security exhibit: proposed redlines, evidence owners, and pen-test window

Tom — thanks for the clarity and for the checklist. We appreciate the flexibility. Karthik and Soojin worked up a practical approach that balances assurance and operational impact:

- Provide SOC 2 Type II (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30) + control mapping + one remote interview with our security lead.
- Offer an observation window for our annual pen-test (2026-11-08 through 2026-12-08) and allow one retest per year with notice. Require submission of a test plan and target list 7 business days ahead.
- On-site reviews only when justified, subject to scope, 30 days' notice, NDA, and Redwood’s audit playbook.

If the SOC 2 + interview model meets GreenBridge’s needs for the customer audit, we can move forward immediately. If GreenBridge requires an on-site review for compliance reasons, please indicate that and we’ll route the formal request through legal with an agreed scope and timeline.

Would you like to schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to finalize? I can send a calendar invite.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
